dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: Arranging flowers really is a science unto itself...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you running into any problems, Pauline?

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: It's not really a big deal.

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: Usually, I always sell flowers by variety, because I think they would be clear to customers at a glance...

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: But recently, I heard that combining several kinds of flowers can make them complement each other and look more beautiful.

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: I tried to match the different flowers, and although I don't quite understand how it works, the business of the shop during the festival is significantly more busy.

dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: So I was wondering, how do you cultivate this particular kind of artistic sense? Do you have to find a professional mentor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, what Pauline said is definitely something worth thinking about.
